payload.task_text:
You are a catering planner for a company team lunch event. The event is for 20 people with a budget of $25 per person. You need to plan a diverse menu, collect dietary preferences from attendees, document the menu, and track the budget.

Your task has four parts.

Part 1: Search the recipe database for 6 to 8 recipes suitable for a team lunch catering event. Select a mix of main dishes and side dishes. For each recipe, note the recipe name, category (such as meat, vegetable, staple, or similar), and estimated number of servings.

Part 2: Create a Google Forms survey titled "Team Lunch Dietary Preferences" to collect dietary information from the 20 attendees. The survey must contain at least 3 questions covering the following topics: dietary restrictions or preferences (such as vegetarian, vegan, nut allergy, gluten-free, or none), any specific food allergies to be aware of, and any additional comments or requests. Use appropriate question types for each question (for example, a multiple-choice question for dietary preferences, and short-answer text questions for allergies and comments).

Part 3: Create a Notion page titled "Team Lunch Menu" documenting the catering plan. The page must include a description of the event (20 people, $25 per person budget), a list of all selected recipes with their categories and serving information, and any notes about accommodating dietary restrictions.

Part 4: Create an Excel file called Catering_Budget.xlsx in the workspace with two sheets. The first sheet must be named "Menu" with the following columns in this exact order: Recipe_Name, Category, Servings, Estimated_Cost_Per_Person. Add one row for each of your selected recipes with a reasonable estimated cost per person. (You may append a "Total" summary row after the recipe rows if you wish; it is not counted as a recipe row.) The second sheet must be named "Summary" with two columns: Metric and Value. Include the following rows: Total_Dishes (number of recipes selected), Total_Budget (total budget for 20 people, which is 500), Budget_Per_Person (which is 25). Write every value in the Summary "Value" column and every Estimated_Cost_Per_Person as a literal number (for example, 500 and 25) — do not write Excel formulas for these cells.

The initial workspace contains Event_Brief.md describing the event details and requirements.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent; do not dispatch sub-agents. Read `Event_Brief.md`, create the fixed Google Form once, and query the necessary HowToCook categories with native-parallel read calls. Select one explicit set of 6–8 recipes containing mains and sides, retrieve only those selected recipes, and reuse exactly that set in both `Team Lunch Menu` and `Catering_Budget.xlsx`. The Form must contain a dietary-preference multiple-choice question plus text questions whose titles explicitly contain `allergy` and `additional comments or requests`. In the workbook, write the exact two sheets and headers, exactly one recipe row per selected dish, literal numeric per-person costs, and literal Summary values `Total_Dishes`, `500`, and `25`; do not use formulas. Create the Notion page and workbook as independent output branches after the recipe set is fixed, and verify the Form, page, and workbook once each.

nodes.text:
You are helping plan a company team lunch catering event (20 people, $25 per person budget, $500 total, buffet style, Q1 team celebration). You must complete TWO external-write tasks using the granted tools.

TASK A — Create a Google Form:
1. Call mcp__google_forms__create_form with title "Team Lunch Dietary Preferences" and a description like "Please help us plan the company team lunch (20 attendees) by sharing your dietary needs."
2. Add these 3 questions to the created form (use the formId returned by create_form):
   - Q1 (multiple choice, required): "Do you have any dietary restrictions or preferences?" with options: "Vegetarian", "Vegan", "Nut allergy", "Gluten-free", "None"
   - Q2 (text, not required): "Please list any specific food allergies we should be aware of."
   - Q3 (text, not required): "Any additional comments or requests for the team lunch?"

TASK B — Create a Notion page:
1. Use mcp__notion__API-post-search (query "Team Lunch" or empty) to find a suitable parent page in the workspace. Create the new page as a child of an appropriate existing top-level page (pick any accessible parent page; if search returns pages, use the first suitable one's id as parent page_id).
2. Create a page titled "Team Lunch Menu" (title property) containing:
   - A heading "Event Overview" and a paragraph describing the event: Company Team Lunch for the Q1 team celebration and planning session, served buffet style, for 20 people, with a budget of $25 per person ($500 total). Beverages are separate.
   - A heading "Selected Menu" followed by a bulleted list of these 8 recipes with category and servings (each dish scaled to serve 20):
     1. 宫保鸡丁 (Kung Pao Chicken) — Meat main — 20 servings
     2. 糖醋里脊 (Sweet and Sour Pork Tenderloin) — Meat main — 20 servings
     3. 黑椒牛柳 (Black Pepper Beef Tenderloin) — Meat main — 20 servings
     4. 麻婆豆腐 (Mapo Tofu) — Meat/tofu main — 20 servings
     5. 地三鲜 (Di San Xian) — Vegetable side — 20 servings
     6. 蒜蓉西兰花 (Garlic Broccoli) — Vegetable side — 20 servings
     7. 酸辣土豆丝 (Hot and Sour Shredded Potato) — Vegetable side — 20 servings
     8. 扬州炒饭 (Yangzhou Fried Rice) — Staple — 20 servings
   - A heading "Dietary Accommodation Notes" with bullets noting: a dietary preference survey (Google Form "Team Lunch Dietary Preferences") is being collected from all 20 attendees before finalizing the menu; vegetable dishes (Di San Xian, Garlic Broccoli, Hot and Sour Shredded Potato) suit vegetarians and a vegan version of Mapo Tofu can be prepared without pork; Kung Pao Chicken contains peanuts and will be clearly labeled / can be substituted for nut-allergy attendees; soy sauce contains gluten, so gluten-free tamari substitutions will be used where needed.

Build the page content with mcp__notion__API-post-page using children blocks (heading_2 and bulleted_list_item / paragraph blocks). You may pass children in the post-page call directly.

Deliverables: report back the Google Form ID and edit/responder URL if available, and the created Notion page ID and URL. Confirm both tasks succeeded.
Create Google Form and Notion page

Create an Excel workbook at exactly this path: /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_Kimi-K3/SingleUserTurn-howtocook-catering-gform-notion-excel/workspace/Catering_Budget.xlsx

Use the mcp__excel__ tools (create_workbook, rename_worksheet, create_worksheet, write_data_to_excel). The workbook must contain exactly two sheets:

SHEET 1 — named "Menu" (rename the default sheet to "Menu"). Columns in this exact order in row 1: Recipe_Name, Category, Servings, Estimated_Cost_Per_Person. Then one row per recipe (8 recipe rows):
1. 宫保鸡丁 (Kung Pao Chicken) | Meat | 20 | 4.5
2. 糖醋里脊 (Sweet and Sour Pork Tenderloin) | Meat | 20 | 4.5
3. 黑椒牛柳 (Black Pepper Beef Tenderloin) | Meat | 20 | 5
4. 麻婆豆腐 (Mapo Tofu) | Meat | 20 | 3
5. 地三鲜 (Di San Xian) | Vegetable | 20 | 2.5
6. 蒜蓉西兰花 (Garlic Broccoli) | Vegetable | 20 | 2
7. 酸辣土豆丝 (Hot and Sour Shredded Potato) | Vegetable | 20 | 1.5
8. 扬州炒饭 (Yangzhou Fried Rice) | Staple | 20 | 2
After the recipe rows, append one summary row: Total | (blank) | (blank) | 25

SHEET 2 — named "Summary". Columns in row 1: Metric, Value. Then rows:
- Total_Dishes | 8
- Total_Budget | 500
- Budget_Per_Person | 25

CRITICAL: All Servings, Estimated_Cost_Per_Person, and Summary "Value" cells must be written as literal numbers (integers/floats), NOT Excel formulas. Use write_data_to_excel with numeric JSON values (e.g. 4.5, 20, 500) so they are stored as numbers.

After writing, verify by reading back both sheets with mcp__excel__read_data_from_excel and confirm the structure and values are correct. Report the final file path and a brief verification summary.
Create Catering_Budget.xlsx file
